SCENE CONTEXT
A lean young Black man with a very short bleached buzz cut and black wraparound tactical glasses stands off to the side of a brutalist octagonal training arena. He turns back toward the lens and delivers one dry, exasperated question.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains him in close-up on the west apron beside the raised platform, near one warm wall sconce, never at platform center. His weight rests on his right hip, chest open, arms loose. The camera is at eye level on his east-west-south three-quarter side, never flat north-frontal. The platform-edge light remains visible as a location anchor.

FORMAT MODE
SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE. One camera, one character, one spoken line, no cuts.

OPTICS
Natural 50mm anamorphic close-up character with shallow separation, soft practical bokeh, restrained flare, stable facial detail, and natural motion blur.

CAMERA
Eye-level handheld with only subtle human micro-drift; no reframing, orbit, push, or second angle.

ACTION TIMING
0:00-0:01.20 — He slowly turns his head to the lens, lifts his chin slightly, begins a half eye-roll, and raises his right eyebrow.
0:01.20-0:03.20 — An asymmetric smirk touches the right corner of his mouth. Maintaining eye contact, he asks in a warm baritone, conversationally quiet and dry: "Are you kidding me?" His lips move only for this exact line.
0:03.20-0:04.00 — A faint head shake resolves "kidding," followed by one slow blink while the smirk holds briefly.

PHYSICS
His weight stays settled on the right hip while the head and face move independently. Preserve continuous breath, jaw, lip, eyelid, cheek, fabric, and glove motion.

LIGHTING
Use only warm amber wall sconces and the platform perimeter light. Photograph him from the shadow side; the nearest sconce gives a small catchlight and rim without frontal fill. Cool concrete and haze remain behind the warm practicals.

AUDIO
Warm baritone dialogue at about 0:01.20, exactly: "Are you kidding me?" Under it, distant HVAC rumble, faint sconce hum, light fabric rustle, a small glove creak, and slow breath. No music, subtitles, or voiceover.

POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
Keep one character, one continuous take, the west-apron position, the three-quarter camera side, tactical glasses on his eyes, and restrained sarcastic performance throughout. No duplicate or extra person; no flat frontal portrait or frontal beauty light.

SCENE CONTEXT
Inside a dark circular brutalist concrete atrium, a human-scale fighter fully enclosed in deep-crimson faceted crystal armor fights a 3.5-meter demon with cracked reddish-brown skin, long black hair, green-yellow eyes, massive arms, and a long bone blade replacing its right forearm. The smaller fighter redirects the demon's power, lands one uppercut, and discovers the demon can rise amused.

LOCATION MAP
Cold grey daylight enters through high clerestory windows. Thick concrete columns remain vertical around a polished intact floor scattered with debris and broken glass. The demon stays screen-left; the crystal fighter stays screen-right. The demon remains a full head and shoulders taller in every shot.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already contains both fighters at close attack range: demon screen-left driving its right-arm bone blade toward screen-right; crystal fighter screen-right with both feet planted and forearms ready. Their scale, attack direction, and eyelines are readable immediately.

FORMAT MODE
CONTROLLED FIVE-SHOT SEQUENCE with HARD CUTS at 0:03.00, 0:05.50, 0:08.50, and 0:11.50. Normal speed except brief slow motion during uppercut contact and the fall.

OPTICS
Medium and tight close-range action coverage with natural perspective, fast-action motion blur, heavy organic grain, and visible deep-red crystal refraction at bright edges. No wide establishing shot.

CAMERA
The camera moves with controlled handheld energy inside each beat while preserving demon-left/fighter-right direction, matched eyelines, relative scale, cold backlight direction, and vertical columns across every cut.

ACTION TIMING
SHOT A — 0:00-0:03.00: In a medium two-shot, the demon swings its bone blade from screen-left. The crystal fighter snaps both forearms up to block. Bone strikes crystal; the fighter's boots slide backward under the larger body's force while he remains upright.
HARD CUT.
SHOT B — 0:03.00-0:05.50: Tight side coverage. The fighter rotates the locked forearms and redirects the blade past his body, drives one crystal shoulder into the demon's exposed ribs, then receives a massive clawed-hand shove and skids back. The demon barely shifts from the shoulder hit.
HARD CUT.
SHOT C — 0:05.50-0:08.50: The demon commits to a straight bone-blade thrust. The fighter sidesteps by inches, catches the extended arm with both hands, and pulls along the thrust path until the demon pitches forward off balance.
HARD CUT.
SHOT D — 0:08.50-0:11.50: The fighter plants both feet, loads hips and shoulder, and drives one full uppercut into the lowered jaw. Brief slow motion isolates crystal-to-jaw contact, head snap, black hair whip, slight body lift, and the demon's gravity-driven fall onto its back. The floor stays intact.
HARD CUT.
SHOT E — 0:11.50-0:15.00: Normal speed returns. The demon presses both hands to the floor, rises section by section to its full 3.5-meter height, turns toward the fighter off frame, and lets its grin return. In a deep resonant voice, genuinely amused, it says exactly in Japanese: "ほう...少しだけ、感じたぞ。" Its lips move only for this line.

PHYSICS
Every contact transfers weight visibly: the block causes boot slide, the redirect follows a rotational path, the smaller shoulder hit barely displaces the demon, the shove displaces the fighter, the arm pull follows existing thrust momentum, and the uppercut begins from planted feet through hip and shoulder rotation before contact and fall. No floating movement or impact without recoil.

LIGHTING
Natural cold grey clerestory daylight only. Keep both fighters backlit or edge-lit with camera-facing planes in shadow. Haze and dust reveal window light; no frontal fill or artificial key.

AUDIO
Atrium room tone, faint high-window wind, bone blade air movement, crystal-on-bone impact and grind, boot friction, body impacts, the uppercut, heavy fall, recovery hand pressure, settling dust, and the final Japanese line. SFX only; no music, subtitles, or voiceover.

POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
Maintain demon-left/fighter-right direction, 3.5-meter-to-human scale, right-arm bone blade, full crystal enclosure, intact floor and architecture, and the same damage state across all cuts. No extra fighters, clones, side swap, weapon swap, crater, or broken column.

The 15-second setting comes from all 11 asset records and explicit user resolution of the Prompt's conflicting 10-second declaration.

seedance_adapter_layer.prompt:
SCENE CONTEXT
A vast tropical Southeast-Asian-inspired megacity sleeps under torrential rain at dead of night. The location is established through a completely locked high-altitude frame, sparse ground traffic, and one metro train crossing an elevated viaduct.

LOCATION MAP
From approximately 600 meters at a 40-degree forward tilt, dense weather-stained mid-rise concrete apartment blocks, rooftop water tanks, wall-mounted air conditioners, wet avenue grids, and several elevated metro viaducts fill the lower two-thirds. A uniformly pitch-black sky with no visible horizon glow fills the upper third. One active viaduct cuts diagonally through the grid.

FIRST FRAME AND SPATIAL BLOCKING
The first visible frame already presents the complete city geography: dark apartment clusters, diagonal viaducts, mostly empty wet roads, isolated sodium pools, scattered window lights and neon, layered rain, and black distance. No foreground person or storefront dominates the frame.

FORMAT MODE
SINGLE CONTINUOUS TAKE. Completely locked stabilized aerial camera; no cuts or transitions.

OPTICS
Very wide natural aerial coverage with fine urban detail, low contrast, restrained anamorphic streaks on bright ground practicals, and no fisheye or miniature appearance.

CAMERA
The camera remains motionless for all 10 seconds: no descent, ascent, push, drift, zoom, rotation, shake, parallax, or reframing. All movement occurs inside the frame.

ACTION TIMING
0:00-0:03.00 — Dense diagonal rain curtains sweep across near, middle, and far depth layers. Mostly empty wet avenues sit between isolated streetlamp pools; one or two distant vehicles appear at long intervals.
0:03.00-0:07.00 — One metro train glides left-to-right along the diagonal elevated viaduct. Its windows stutter past stained piers while one car and one motorbike trace brief light paths through the road grid below.
0:07.00-0:10.00 — The train clears frame-right. Rain density holds and sparse ground movement continues without escalation as the city fades into black distance.

PHYSICS
Rain direction stays consistent across all depth layers. Vehicles remain on visible roads. The train remains on its rails at a steady speed. The locked camera creates no parallax or platform motion.

LIGHTING
The sky remains uniformly black with no moon, stars, horizon glow, or illuminated clouds. All light comes from ground-level sodium streetlamps, apartment windows, sparse neon, vehicle lights, and train windows. Keep cool desaturated darkness with isolated sodium-orange and red accents diffused by rain.

AUDIO
Torrential rain strikes rooftops, roads, and concrete. Faint intermittent traffic and quiet overnight city ambience remain distant. The metro train's soft mechanical rumble rises during the crossing and recedes after it exits. No drone sound, thunder, dialogue, or music.

POSITIVE CONSTRAINTS
Keep the camera, altitude, tilt, city layout, exposure, rain direction, and black sky fixed throughout. Show only one train and sparse traffic. Exclude the originating pizzeria storefront, checkerboard awning, pizza signage, readable English brand logos, foreground characters, visible drone, drone shadow, and drone reflection.

notes: Ten seconds is sourced from all 17 asset metadata records, not from the Prompt text.
The static camera case demonstrates that an establishing shot can remain dynamic through weather, traffic, and transit motion.
